ceu: ✦ The trine between Mercury and Pluto

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The trine between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.
